versions.title: Brown Butter Cornbread
versions.description: A skillet cornbread with a nutty, golden crumb.
versions.version_notes: First pass: plain melted butter as a baseline.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F with the skillet inside.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Pour into the hot skillet and bake 20 to 22 minutes, until the top is golden.

test_sessions.notes: Good rise, crumb a bit dry at the edges.
test_sessions.outcome: Fine baseline. Try brown butter next.

versions.title: Brown Butter Cornbread
versions.description: A skillet cornbread with a nutty, golden crumb.
versions.version_notes: Brown the butter and add a spoon of honey. Two minutes less in the oven.
steps: Brown the butter in the skillet over medium heat, then pour it into a bowl to cool.
Heat the oven to 425°F with the skillet inside.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs, honey and brown butter, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Pour into the hot skillet and bake about 20 minutes, until the top is golden.

test_sessions.notes: Much nuttier. Edges crisp, middle moist.
test_sessions.outcome: Keeper. Maybe a pinch more salt.

versions.title: Lemon Olive Oil Cake
versions.description: A tender loaf cake with a lemon syrup soak.
versions.version_notes: Starting point from a family card.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a loaf pan.
Rub the lemon zest into the sugar, then whisk in the eggs and olive oil.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes, then brush with lemon juice while warm.

test_sessions.notes: Domed and cracked on top. Lemon flavor faint.
test_sessions.outcome: Needs more zest and a real syrup.
